sections.title: The letter che
paragraphs: The letter name is (че) /tɕe/. Its main sound is heard in (час) /tɕas/, which means hour. This letter has two sounds.

sections.title: Pronouncing che
paragraphs: Press the blade of your tongue against the ridge behind your upper teeth. Raise the middle of your tongue toward the roof of your mouth. Release the air with a soft hiss and keep your voice off. For the other sound, do not block the air. Push the air through that narrow gap longer. Touch your throat to feel that it does not shake.

sections.title: Spelling of che
paragraphs: This letter usually sounds soft, as in (чай) /tɕaj/. Before the letter en in certain frequent words, sound change happens. There it sounds like a long hiss, as heard in (конечно) /kɐˈnʲeɕːnə/ and (скучно) /ˈskuɕːnə/.

sections.title: Avoiding mistakes with che
paragraphs: Do not pronounce it like the hard sound in chair. In cheese, your tongue raises higher toward the roof of your mouth. Make the sound softer and keep your lips relaxed. For the sound in (скучно) /ˈskuɕːnə/, do not stop the air like in match. Keep the air flowing smoothly.
